[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
John Glasgow was born on 13 February 1816 in Airdrie, Lanarkshire, Scotland. He was the son of John Glasgow and Marion Anderson.<ref name=Death/> <ref name=2Marriage/>

John married Christian Forsyth on or after 29 February 1836 in the parish of Airdrie or New Monkland.<ref>"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Banns and Marriages," database, National Records of Scotland, ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 6 August 2026), John Glasgow marriage to Christian Forsyth on or after 29 Feb 1836 in Airdrie or New Monkland, Scotland; citing Parish Number: 651; Ref: 70/199; Frame: 1769.</ref>

By 1841, John and Christian were living at Arden in Clarkston, Lanarkshire, with their young daughters Helen and Marion. John was employed in the iron industry, recorded in the census as an "Iron M."<ref name=1841c>"1841 Scotland Census," database, ({{Ancestry Record|1004|490521}} : $, accessed 6 August 2026), Name: John Glasgow; Age: 25; Estimated Birth Year: abt 1816; Gender: Male; Where born: Lanarkshire, Scotland; Civil parish: Clarkston; County: Lanarkshire; Address: Arden; Occupation: Iron M; citing Parish: Clarkston; ED: 6b; Page: 16; Line: 1370; Year: 1841; Parish Number: 651.

In 1851, the family was living at 37 Aitcheson Street in New Monkland. John was working as an ironstone miner, and the household included five children: Helen, Matthew, John, Ann, and Elizabeth. Christian's mother, Helen Brown, was also staying with the family and was employed as a tambourer.<ref>"1851 Scotland Census," database, ({{Ancestry Record|1076|2664972}} : $, accessed 6 August 2026), Name: John Glasgow; Age: 35; Estimated Birth Year: abt 1816; Relationship: Head; Spouse: Christina Forsyth; Gender: Male; Where born: Airdrie, Lanarkshire; Civil parish: New Monkland; County: Lanarkshire; Address: 37 Aitcheson St; Occupation: Ironstone Miner; ED: 8; citing Parish: New Monkland; ED: 8; Page: 16; Line: 10; Roll: CSSCT1851_170; Year: 1851; Parish Number: 651; Household schedule number: 57.

John became a widower in 1858 when Christian died at the age of forty-three.<ref>"Statutory Register of Deaths," database, National Records of Scotland, ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 6 August 2026), Christina Glasgow death registered 1858 in Airdrie or New Monkland (age 43, mother's maiden name Brown); citing Ref: 651/1/148.</ref>

The following year, John married Helen Murray in New Monkland. Their marriage was registered in 1859 in the New Monkland Landward district.
<ref>({{Ancestry Record|60144|3034301}} : $, accessed 6 August 2026).</ref> <ref name=2Marriage>"Statutory Register of Marriages," database, National Records of Scotland, ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 6 August 2026), John Glasgow marriage to Helen Murray registered 1859 in New Monkland Landward; citing Ref: 651/2/11.</ref>

Only a few months after their marriage, Helen became involved in a criminal case. On 4 October 1859, Helen Glasgow, identified as the wife of John Glasgow, miner of Airdrie, and with maiden surname Murray, appeared before the High Court of Justiciary in Glasgow on a charge of theft and previous conviction. She was found guilty in terms of her own confession and sentenced to four years' penal servitude.<ref>National Records of Scotland,  JC26 and JC26/1859 high Court of Justiciary process https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=JC26%2f1859%2f292&df&dt&r&di=y&k=John+Glasgow&ko=p&ro=s&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&utm_source=chatgpt.com Accessed 6 Aug 2026 </ref>

In 1861, John was living at 45 Aitchison Street in New Monkland with six of his children. He was then employed as a coal miner, and his sons Matthew and John were also working in the mines. His daughter Anna was employed as a cotton weaver.<ref>"1861 Scotland Census," database, ({{Ancestry Record|1080|312854}} : $, accessed 6 August 2026), Name: John Glasgow; Age: 44; Estimated Birth Year: abt 1817; Relationship: Head; Gender: Male; Where born: Airdrie, New Monkland; Registration District: Airdrie; Civil parish: New Monkland; County: Lanarkshire; Address: 45 Aitchison St; Occupation: Coal Miner; ED: 7; citing Parish: New Monkland; ED: 7; Page: 11; Line: 6; Roll: CSSCT1861_117; Registration Number: 651/1; Household schedule number: 56.

John Glasgow died on 25 April 1867 in Airdrie, Lanarkshire, Scotland, at the age of fifty-one.  <ref name=Death>"Statutory Register of Deaths," database, National Records of Scotland, ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 6 August 2026), John Glasgow death registered 1867 in Airdrie or New Monkland (age 51); citing Ref: 651/1/97.</ref>
